name: qlaundry
description: Laundry management system in Clean Architecture. Monorepo with a React frontend and a Java/Spring Boot backend.

paragraphs: A multi-tenant laundry management system: each laundry business (a tenant) manages its staff, customers, price list, orders, invoices, promo codes and business reports from one web app. Monorepo with a React frontend, five Java/Spring Boot services and an nginx gateway. The UI is in Indonesian.
features: Tenant onboarding — a laundry registers itself (with a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), confirms by email, and its first account becomes the super-staff. Unconfirmed registrations expire after 30 days.
Staff accounts — STAFF and SUPERSTAFF roles, self-service profile, password reset by emailed OTP, and no password reuse within 90 days.
Customers — a per-tenant customer book with phone/email/address. Phone numbers are normalised (0812…, 62812…, +62 812… are the same number).
Price list — laundry services priced per kg or per unit, with categories, estimated hours and an optional express option (its own hours and price multiplier).

Machines — the laundry's washers, dryers and irons. Staff pick the machines an order runs on when they start processing it and can swap them while it is in progress; a machine can't be on two in-progress orders at once.

whatItDoes.text: A multi-tenant laundry management system: each laundry business (a tenant) manages its staff, customers, price list, orders, invoices, promo codes and business reports from one web app. Monorepo with a React frontend, five Java/Spring Boot services and an nginx gateway. The UI is in Indonesian.

requirements.text: Register a laundry, open the confirmation email in Mailpit, click the link, then log in.

nginx serves the frontend (including Vite HMR) and forwards /api/ to the owning service with the /api prefix stripped (/api/auth/staff/login → /auth/staff/login), so the browser sees a single origin and there is no CORS.
